sprints.name: Hardware, devices and troubleshooting
sprints.outcome: Identify, install and troubleshoot PC, laptop, mobile and printer hardware with one troubleshooting method.

sprints.name: Networking fundamentals
sprints.outcome: Explain how data moves, build a small switched and routed network, and troubleshoot it from cable to application.

sprints.name: Operating systems, security and support
sprints.outcome: Install and support Windows, find your way around macOS and Linux, remove malware and close a support ticket.

sprints.name: Lab and foundations
sprints.outcome: A working lab you can roll back with snapshots, and comfort with the command line on Windows and Linux.

sprints.name: Networking and name resolution
sprints.outcome: Design and troubleshoot addressing, DNS and DHCP on both platforms.

sprints.name: Identity and directory services
sprints.outcome: Build and run an Active Directory domain and manage its users and computers with Group Policy.

sprints.name: Hybrid identity and governance
sprints.outcome: Connect on-premises identity to the cloud and control access and cost there.

sprints.name: Compute and virtualization
sprints.outcome: Deploy and manage servers on-premises and in Azure, and explain when each one fits.

sprints.name: Storage and file services
sprints.outcome: Provide and protect storage for users and workloads on-premises and in Azure.

sprints.name: Security and hardening
sprints.outcome: Measure a server against a baseline and fix the gaps.

sprints.name: Monitoring, backup and troubleshooting
sprints.outcome: Watch systems, restore them, and trace faults step by step.

sprints.name: Automation and infrastructure as code
sprints.outcome: Build repeatable environments from code instead of by hand.

sprints.name: Cloud architecture and operations
sprints.outcome: Choose a cloud design for a given workload and defend its cost, risk and migration plan.

sprints.name: Linux services and advanced administration
sprints.outcome: Run the core network services and manage boot, kernel and capacity on Linux.

sprints.name: Security operations, governance and risk
sprints.outcome: Detect and respond to incidents and explain security in business terms.

sprints.name: Containers, virtualization and high availability
sprints.outcome: Run and secure containers and design for availability.

sprints.name: Capstone
sprints.outcome: One environment that uses every earlier sprint, reviewed by a peer.

sprints.name: Cisco routing and switching
sprints.outcome: Build, secure and troubleshoot a small Cisco campus network, and check what automation and AI tools produce.

tracks.name: Skills only
tracks.blurb: All 14 core sprints (S0 to S13), no exams.

tracks.name: Microsoft
tracks.blurb: Windows Server and Azure, ending in two Microsoft exams: AZ-802 (Windows Server) and AZ-104 (Azure).

tracks.name: Linux
tracks.blurb: Linux+, then LPIC-1, LPIC-2 and LPIC-3, with Linux as your main lab work.

tracks.name: Security
tracks.blurb: Hardening, monitoring and security operations, ending in Security+.

tracks.name: Everyone
tracks.blurb: Every sprint except N1 (Cisco): Foundations, then the 14 core sprints, with their exams.
tracks.fit: A mix, or growing into a senior generalist

tracks.name: Foundations
tracks.blurb: New to IT? Start here: hardware, networking, operating systems and support, with A+ and Network+ along the way. Then pick B, C or D.
tracks.fit: New to IT, help desk and desktop support

tracks.name: Networking
tracks.blurb: Cisco routing and switching on top of networking basics, ending in the CCNA. New to IT? Do Track F first.
tracks.fit: Network administration and network operations center (NOC) jobs

certs.name: CompTIA A+
certs.what: IT support: hardware, operating systems and troubleshooting (two exams)

certs.name: LPIC-1
certs.what: Linux administration, from the Linux Professional Institute (two exams)
